district.name: Kodagu
district.description: Known as 'Scotland of India', Kodagu is celebrated for misty coffee plantations, Talakaveri (source of River Cauvery), Abbey Falls, Raja's Seat in Madikeri, Dubare Elephant Camp, and Namdroling Golden Temple.
district.descriptionKannada: 'ಭಾರತದ ಸ್ಕಾಟ್‌ಲ್ಯಾಂಡ್' ಕೊಡಗು, ಮಂಜಿನ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟಗಳು, ಕಾವೇರಿಯ ಉಗಮ ತಲಕಾವೇರಿ, ಅಬ್ಬಿ ಜಲಪಾತ, ಮಡಿಕೇರಿಯ ರಾಜಾಸೀಟ್, ದುಬಾರೆ ಆನೆ ಶಿಬಿರ ಮತ್ತು ಬೈಲಕುಪ್ಪೆಯ ಗೋಲ್ಡನ್ ಟೆಂಪಲ್‌ಗೆ ಖ್ಯಾತ.

destinations.name: Talakaveri & Bhagamandala (Source of River Cauvery)
destinations.description: The holy birthplace of Mother Cauvery (Kaveri Amma) perched 1,276 meters high on the slopes of the Brahmagiri hill. Features the sacred spring pool (Kundike) where the river miraculously surges on Tula Sankramana day in October, paired with the Triveni Sangama in Bhagamandala below and a panoramic viewpoint staircase atop Brahmagiri.
destinations.historicalSignificance: The lifeline river of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu; puranic legend relates how Sage Agastya's water pot was tipped by Lord Ganesha in crow form.
destinations.culturalImportance: The holiest spiritual center for the Kodava community and millions of South Indians; sacred teerthoddbhava witnessed by tens of thousands.
destinations.bestSeason: October to March (Tula Sankramana in mid-October)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 8 km from Bhagamandala, 45 km from Madikeri
destinations.nearestBusStation: Bhagamandala Bus Stand (8 km) / Talakaveri Temple Bus Stop (0.1 km)
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Kannur Railway Station (110 km) or Mysuru (165 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved mountain ghat road winding up through lush coffee and cardamom estates
destinations.trekkingDifficulty: Easy to Moderate (350 stone steps to Brahmagiri peak viewpoint)
destinations.safetyInstructions: Traditional modest clothing required inside temple precincts. Brahmagiri peak trail is very windy; walk carefully on steps.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Temple trust managed; open public entry

destinations.name: Namdroling Monastery (The Golden Temple), Bylakuppe
destinations.description: The largest teaching center of Nyingma lineage Tibetan Buddhism in the world, home to over 5,000 monks and nuns. Features the awe-inspiring Padmasambhava Buddhist Vihara housing three magnificent 40-foot gilded copper statues of Buddha Shakyamuni, Guru Padmasambhava, and Buddha Amitayus, surrounded by ornate murals and prayer wheels.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Established in 1963 by His Holiness Penor Rinpoche after his departure from Tibet; settled under the generous land grant of Mysore Maharaja Jayachamarajendra Wadiyar.
destinations.culturalImportance: A vibrant slice of authentic Tibetan culture, philosophy, traditional thangka painting, and peaceful meditation.
destinations.bestSeason: Year-round (Tibetan New Year Losar in February/March is festive)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 6 km from Kushalnagar, 35 km from Madikeri, 85 km from Mysuru
destinations.nearestBusStation: Bylakuppe Cross Bus Stop (1 km) / Kushalnagar Bus Stand (6 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Situated just 2 km off National Highway 275 with ample parking
destinations.safetyInstructions: Maintain silence inside temple prayer halls. Spin prayer wheels in clockwise direction. Remove shoes before entering.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Open visitor entry; foreign nationals need Protected Area Permit (PAP) only for overnight stays in Tibetan camps
